channel.title: mint - news
channel.description: Get the latest news and analysis on business, finance, politics from mint, the website of the Mint newspaper, one of India's leading business and financial dailies

item.title: 'We'll come and see': On NEET, SC says will inspect NTA office; seeks report on progress by Nandan Nilekani panel
item.description: NEET exam row: The Centre told the Supreme Court that the panel has held exhaustive consultations and is likely to submit its first interim report by the end of this month.

item.title: Delhi High Court says payments to overseas units aren't automatically taxable in India
item.description: The dispute involved payments made by Ranbaxy, now merged with Sun Pharmaceutical Industries Ltd, to Teva Israel under a 2011 settlement relating to the US launch of generic atorvastatin.

item.title: Daughter's school bus takes 2 hours to cover 2 km in Bengaluru; parent says 'completely helpless'
item.description: A Bengaluru father’s account of his daughter’s school bus taking two hours to travel just 2 km on the Varthur-Gunjur road has sparked concern online. Other parents have shared similar experiences, calling for safer roads and better traffic management in the city.

item.title: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times in US days after DHS's ‘Mr Singh’ post
item.description: Sikh truck driver stabbed 17 times at a Wyoming rest stop, days after DHS posted an AI-generated graphic mocking a Sikh ‘Mr Singh’. Sikh groups, Hindu American Foundation and Rep. Krishnamoorthi condemned the attack, linking it to rising anti-Sikh profiling concerns.

item.title: Watch: Vicky Kaushal joins iPhone 18 frenzy, poses with Pro Max at Apple BKC
item.description: The iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max went on sale in India on September 18, drawing customers to Apple stores across the country. Among the launch-day buyers was actor Vicky Kaushal, who picked up the iPhone 18 Pro Max at Apple BKC in Mumbai.

item.title: Laid off at 59 after 3 decades at HP, she found a new career in Antarctica: Her story
item.description: May Lee expected to retire from Hewlett-Packard after three decades at the company. But a layoff at 59, followed by an unsuccessful job search, prompted her to rethink her next move. She eventually took a lower-paying job at McMurdo Station in Antarctica.

item.title: Petrol at ₹384, Pakistan introduces austerity measures — one dish at marriage events, markets to be shut by 9 pm
item.description: The Pakistan government notified sweeping austerity and fuel conservation measures to conserve energy as fuel prices spike due to the Middle East conflict, with all shops, markets, and shopping malls in Islamabad closing at 9pm throughout the week.

item.title: US approves UNGA visa for Iran’s Pezeshkian amid war: What is Washington’s UN obligation?
item.description: The US has approved visas for Iranian officials to attend the UNGA in New York, adhering to its host country obligations, despite ongoing military conflict. The Iranian delegation will be smaller and face tighter restrictions compared to previous years, reflecting complex diplomatic dynamics.

item.title: Karnataka movie tickets to cost more from Sept 30: What the new 2% cess means for moviegoers
item.description: Moviegoers in Karnataka could see higher cinema ticket costs from September 30, when an additional cess of up to 2% is set to take effect. The Multiplex Association of India has raised concerns over the move, saying it could increase the cost of theatrical entertainment for consumers.

item.title: CBDT extends deadline for tax valuer, practitioner registrations to March 2027
item.description: The six-month extension gives valuers and authorized income-tax practitioners more time to register under the Income-tax Act, 2025, with CBDT also replacing the prescribed application forms.

item.title: Pit bull mauls 6-month-old during walk in Haryana's Sonipat; baby critical, CCTV captures attack
item.description: A six-month-old girl was critically injured after a pit bull attacked her in Haryana’s Sonipat while she was being taken out for a walk by her aunt. CCTV footage captured the dog lunging at the woman and subsequently mauling the baby.

item.title: Flooding Kills Three People as Heavy Rains Hit Northern Vietnam
item.description: Heavy rains triggered flooding and landslides across northern Vietnam, killing three people and damaging thousands of homes as well as more than 22,000 hectares of crops.

item.title: ‘Sabse pahele lena humnein hai’: Apple iPhone 18 Pro, Pro Max sparks pre-dawn rush in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru
item.description: Apple’s iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max went on sale in India on September 18, with customers gathering outside Apple stores in Delhi, Mumbai and Bengaluru to get their hands on the new flagship models.

item.title: India remains net steel importer for fifth straight month in August
item.description: India remained a net finished-steel importer for the fifth month in August as imports rose 8% year-on-year, even as exports jumped 31.3%, driven partly by demand for value-added re-exports.

item.title: Saudi Arabia turns to China for help as Houthis' advances threaten oil exports. Here's what Beijing, Tehran said
item.description: China reportedly wants Iran to use its influence with the Houthis to help prevent the conflict from spreading further across energy routes on which China, the world's second-largest economy, depend

item.title: Petrol, diesel prices today, September 18: Check rates in Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru
item.description: Petrol and diesel prices were unchanged across major Indian cities on September 18, while CNG rates continued to differ by city. Here are the latest fuel prices and the key development concerning UPI payments at petrol pumps.

item.title: US clears $24.3 billion F-35 sale to Saudi Arabia: Why the deal matters and China factor explained
item.description: The proposed sale comes after the Houthis in Yemen claimed on 16 September that they have shot down a Saudi F-15 fighter jet over Marib, a key city in their battle against Saudi-backed Yemeni forces.

item.title: El Niño puts India on course for driest monsoon in 17 years; crop yields and food prices at risk
item.description: India is on course for its driest monsoon in 17 years, with rainfall 15% below normal so far. A strengthening El Niño is raising concerns over crop yields and food inflation, which hit 5.95% in August.

item.title: US-Iran war LIVE Updates: Pakistan's Asim Munir urges Iran to curb Houthi attacks on Saudi Arabia, says report
item.description: US-Iran war LIVE Updates: US President Donald Trump reportedly said that Iran wants a deal but is “not ready” and said the US “controls” the Strait of Hormuz. Asked about further deployments or a deal, he said: “I think we’ll end up winning.”

item.title: Trump says ‘big decision’ coming on Iran war as he prepares to meet six Gulf leaders at UN General Assembly
item.description: Trump said his next move on Iran would be influenced by discussions with leaders of six Gulf countries whom he is due to meet in New York next Tuesday on the sidelines of the United Nations General Assembly.

item.title: Israeli envoy Danny Danon calls for Mamdani’s arrest ahead of Netanyahu’s New York visit
item.description: Speaking to reporters at the UN on Thursday, Danon accused Mamdani of incitement and of collaborating with an enemy of the United States. His remarks came days before Netanyahu is expected to address the UN General Assembly.

item.title: Intense Heat Strains Power Grids for 100 Million North Americans
item.description: Power grids serving more than 100 million North Americans are bracing for a demand surge as unseasonable heat strains electrical equipment scheduled for repairs.

item.title: Travis Scott, PinkPantheress, Keith Richards: GTA 6 unveils first six singles from upcoming album, check artists
item.description: Grand Theft Auto VI soundtrack album will be released alongside the video game on November 19. &nbsp;It consists of 34 tracks.

item.title: Canada steps up India trade talks, fourth CEPA round underway
item.description: Canada's international trade minister is visiting Mumbai to accelerate negotiations on a bilateral economic partnership aimed at doubling trade to 70 billion Canadian dollars by 2030.&nbsp;

item.title: Passport rules 2026: Children under 15 get new validity terms; Check revised fresh, renewal and tatkaal fees
item.description: Under the amended rules, a 36-page ordinary passport issued to a child below 15 years of age will be valid for five years from the date of issue or until the child turns 18, whichever comes first.

item.title: Delhi horror: Four teenagers held over gang-rape, murder of 16-year-old girl; here's how police cracked the case
item.description: A 19-year-old man was arrested and three minors apprehended in connection with the gang-rape and murder of a 16-year-old girl in north Delhi. Her body was found with multiple stab wounds, and knives linked to the crime have been recovered.

item.title: This ‘weird cat’ had scientists stunned—It’s a new species discovered after 100 years
item.description: The finding is significant because it represents the first new felid species discovered in more than a century. The previous new cat species was the pampas cat, described in 1923.

item.title: Mamata Banerjee losing TMC? Election Commission freezes Trinamool Congress name and party symbol
item.description: The Election Commission has frozen the name and symbol of Mamata Banerjee’s Trinamool Congress. Meetings with 'Kalighat Trinamool' and 'Ritobroto Trinamool' resulted in an interim order.
